title: Staff Obligation
summary: Your duties and what Zura Spa expects from you.

sections.title: Staff Obligations
paragraphs: Every staff member of Zura Spa is responsible for understanding and upholding the standards, policies, procedures and culture of the spa. Working with Zura Spa comes with the obligation to act professionally, responsibly and in a manner that protects the client, the team and the business.

sections.title: 1. Professional Conduct
paragraphs: Staff are expected to:
list: Conduct themselves professionally at all times while on the premises.
Be disciplined, responsible and intentional about their work.
Follow all approved SOPs, instructions and operational procedures.
Treat clients, colleagues and leaders with courtesy and respect.
Maintain appropriate professional boundaries.
Take responsibility for their actions and decisions.
Avoid behaviour that may compromise the safety, reputation or operation of Zura Spa.
Maintain a serious and professional attitude toward their work.

sections.title: 2. Teamwork, Impartiality & Professional Boundaries
paragraphs: Every staff member is obligated to work as part of a professional team. Personal relationships must not interfere with workplace responsibilities, decisions or standards.

Zura Spa does not operate on a friendship or family attitude. Staff may have friendships, family relationships or personal relationships with one another outside work, but these relationships must remain separate from workplace responsibilities.
Staff are expected to:
list: Work as a team toward the goals and standards of Zura Spa.
Treat colleagues fairly and professionally.
Make decisions based on facts, responsibilities and company standards.
Avoid personal bias, favouritism and preferential treatment.
Avoid stereotypes or assumptions about colleagues based on their background, personality, relationships or personal circumstances.
Not protect or excuse a friend, relative or preferred colleague from accountability.
Not use friendship or family relationships to gain special treatment.
Not allow personal disagreements to affect professional responsibilities.
Respect every person's assigned role and responsibility.
Support colleagues in achieving the required standard without taking over their responsibilities.
Address work-related concerns through the appropriate communication and escalation channels rather than through personal relationships.
Keep personal friendships, family relationships and social relationships separate from workplace decisions.

sections.title: Professional, Not Personal
paragraphs: Staff are not required to be friends with one another. They are required to:
list: Work well together.
Communicate appropriately.
Respect professional boundaries.
Cooperate where work requires it.
Uphold the same standards.
Remain fair and objective.
sections.closing: Being close to someone outside work does not make that person more entitled to support, protection or preferential treatment inside Zura Spa. Likewise, disliking someone personally does not justify treating them unfairly. At Zura Spa, we work as a team, but we remain professional individuals. Our standard is: No bias. No favouritism. No stereotypes. No friendship privilege. No family privilege. Just professional teamwork, accountability and fairness.

sections.title: 3. Attendance & Resumption
paragraphs: Staff are obligated to:
list: Resume work according to their agreed schedule.
Sign in and sign out using the approved attendance application.
Be present for the daily morning routine by 9:00 AM when scheduled to work.
Notify the appropriate channel when they are unable to meet their expected schedule.
Observe their agreed workdays and working hours.
Remain available and productive during their scheduled working period.
Understand that late bookings may require work beyond 10:00 PM.

sections.title: 4. Appearance & Grooming
paragraphs: Every staff member is responsible for maintaining the required professional appearance. Staff must:
list: Arrive clean and well-groomed.
Maintain a neat, polished and prestigious appearance.
Follow the approved hairstyle requirements.
Wear an approved wig or scarf where applicable.
Not wear cornrows.
Wear the approved uniform while working.
Arrive in mufti and change into uniform at the facility.
Change back into mufti before leaving the facility.

sections.title: 5. Hygiene & Cleanliness
paragraphs: Hygiene is a collective obligation. Every staff member must contribute to keeping the spa clean and hygienic. Staff are expected to:
list: Keep their assigned room clean.
Pick up trash when they see it.
Clean the toilet after use.
Properly handle and return used towels.
Ensure towels are washed according to the established procedure.
Maintain personal hygiene.
Report hygiene issues through the appropriate channel.
Never intentionally leave a mess for another staff member.
Take responsibility for cleanliness rather than assuming another person will handle it.

sections.title: 6. Client Safety, Privacy & Confidentiality
paragraphs: Staff have an obligation to protect client safety and privacy. Staff must:
list: Keep client information confidential.
Not discuss client sessions outside approved company channels.
Not disclose private client information to friends, family or outsiders.
Submit session reports through the appropriate channel.
Maintain professional boundaries with clients.
Not give clients personal phone numbers.
Not disclose unnecessary personal information to clients.
Follow all approved client-safety procedures.
sections.closing: Zura Spa does not provide sexual services. Staff must maintain clear professional boundaries at all times.

sections.title: 7. Communication & Escalation
paragraphs: Staff are obligated to use the company's established communication system. They must:
list: Use the appropriate WhatsApp group for work-related communication.
Keep important workplace communication within company channels as much as possible.
Read and understand the purpose of each WhatsApp group.
Remain active and responsive in relevant groups.
Use the established escalation process for conflicts, disagreements and concerns.
Escalate issues rather than confront colleagues.
Personally escalate matters that they are responsible for escalating.
Notify the appropriate leader when an escalation has been made through the required channel.
sections.closing: Staff must not use gossip, private discussions or informal alliances as substitutes for the company's communication and escalation system.

sections.title: 8. Respect for the Chain of Responsibility
paragraphs: Every staff member must understand their position within the team structure. Staff are expected to:
list: Respect assigned roles and responsibilities.
Follow the appropriate chain of communication.
Avoid unnecessarily bypassing responsible team members.
Direct issues to the appropriate person or channel.
Respect leadership decisions while retaining the right to raise concerns through the proper channel.
sections.closing: New therapists must follow the onboarding structure through the Therapist Guide and Lead Therapist before becoming fully integrated into the team.

sections.title: 9. Individual Responsibility
paragraphs: Staff are expected to take responsibility for themselves and their assigned duties. This includes:
list: Coming to work prepared.
Bringing necessary personal items rather than unnecessarily borrowing from colleagues.
Keeping personal belongings in the designated staff area.
Remaining in their assigned room unless there is a legitimate reason to leave.
Avoiding unnecessary movement around the facility.
Avoiding loitering.
Avoiding gossip.
Avoiding unnecessary social gatherings during work.
Taking responsibility for problems they notice rather than assuming someone else will handle them.
Understanding that personal comfort or convenience does not take priority over workplace standards.

sections.title: 10. Safe-Space Responsibility
paragraphs: Every staff member has an obligation to contribute to a safe working environment. Staff must not:
list: Threaten colleagues.
Intimidate colleagues.
Shout at colleagues.
Harass colleagues.
Engage in aggressive confrontation.
Create unnecessary conflict.
Use personal relationships to influence workplace decisions.
Retaliate against someone for making a legitimate escalation.
Create an environment where another staff member feels unsafe or pressured.
sections.closing: Where there is disagreement, staff are expected to use the appropriate communication or escalation channel.

sections.title: 11. Food & Facility Resources
paragraphs: Staff are obligated to use facility resources responsibly. They must:
list: Eat only in the designated kitchen/eating area.
Clean up after eating.
Cook in a manner that does not interfere with spa operations.
Avoid creating food smells in client-facing or treatment areas.
Use facility resources responsibly.
Follow the sleep-over rules when staying overnight.
Not unnecessarily use AC, water heaters or other restricted resources during sleep-overs.
Use fans where permitted during sleep-overs.
Keep personal belongings in the designated staff area.
Avoid leaving personal items around the facility.

sections.title: 12. Client Experience
paragraphs: Every staff member contributes to the client's perception of Zura Spa. Staff are therefore obligated to:
list: Make clients feel safe, warm, relaxed and welcomed.
Speak softly and kindly.
Walk softly.
Avoid loud conversations.
Avoid loud conversations with colleagues in the presence of clients.
Give clients appropriate attention.
Maintain a calm and professional environment.
Protect the client's privacy.
Remember that the client's experience takes priority over casual staff interaction.

sections.title: 13. Training & Development
paragraphs: Staff have an obligation to continuously improve. They must:
list: Participate in required courses and training.
Attend training whether scheduled on duty or off duty where participation is required.
Learn and understand updated SOPs.
Ask questions when they do not understand a procedure.
Apply training to their daily work.
Accept coaching and constructive feedback.
Demonstrate a willingness to grow.

sections.title: 14. Performance & Accountability
paragraphs: Staff are accountable for how they conduct themselves throughout the month.
Zura Spa maintains a monthly performance sheet that evaluates staff based on their overall conduct, performance and compliance within the spa.
Staff are therefore obligated to consistently demonstrate:
list: Punctuality.
Discipline.
Hygiene.
Professionalism.
Good client conduct.
Compliance.
Accountability.
Team responsibility.
Proper communication.
Respect for workplace standards.
Willingness to improve.
Professional conduct toward colleagues and leaders.
sections.closing: Staff should not wait for a monthly review before correcting poor behaviour. Performance is built through daily conduct.

sections.title: 15. Property & Security
paragraphs: Staff are responsible for protecting the property entrusted to them. They must:
list: Respect client property.
Respect company property.
Respect colleagues' property.
Keep personal belongings in designated areas.
Report suspected theft or loss through the appropriate channel.
Never take, hide, misuse or retain another person's property without authorization.
sections.closing: Theft of client, company or staff property is a serious breach of company standards.

sections.title: 16. Financial & Client Boundaries
paragraphs: Staff must comply with all company rules relating to client payments and tips. Staff must:
list: Not arrange private payments with clients.
Not request that clients transfer tips directly to personal accounts.
Direct tips through the approved front-desk/company process.
Not use the client relationship for unauthorized personal financial gain.
Not negotiate or offer unauthorized services to clients.
Maintain professional boundaries in all financial interactions with clients.

sections.title: 17. Obligation to Report & Escalate
paragraphs: Staff have a responsibility to report matters that may affect:
list: Client safety.
Staff safety.
Hygiene.
Security.
Service quality.
Company property.
Confidentiality.
Compliance.
Workplace harmony.
Operational standards.
sections.closing: The purpose of reporting is not to create conflict. It is to allow the company to identify problems, correct issues, improve standards and protect the team. Staff are expected to escalate rather than confront, gossip or retaliate.

sections.title: 18. Compliance Is Mandatory
paragraphs: Zura Spa's standards are not optional suggestions.
Every staff member is expected to understand that continued engagement with the spa requires compliance with applicable company policies, procedures and reasonable workplace instructions.

Failure to meet staff obligations may result in corrective action or sanctions, including financial sanctions, suspension or termination where appropriate and in accordance with applicable law and the staff member's agreement.
sections.closing: The standard is simple: Do your work. Protect the client. Protect the team. Protect the spa. Communicate properly. Work professionally with everyone. Escalate responsibly. Avoid personal bias. Respect boundaries. Maintain the standard.
